reads.license: Public GIAB HG002 data (Google DeepVariant case-study test data)
reads.selection: samtools view -s 7.0286 (2.86% of the 35x reads, about 1x) of the window

panel.license: 1000 Genomes / IGSR: free to use without restriction
panel.selection: the window's biallelic SNPs with minor allele frequency >= 1%, all 3,202 samples; ID, QUAL, INFO and every FORMAT but GT dropped

truth.selection: the window; INFO and every FORMAT but GT dropped; BED clipped to it

chip.selection: 23andMe v5 (2025) template chr20 positions, lifted to GRCh38 with UCSC hg19ToHg38, at the panel's sites inside the confident BED: GIAB genotype, else 0/0; contig named 20. Probe 20:10008603 is a simulated ./., to test that Beagle-filled chip no-calls remain labelled imputed (#621).
